sentences.text: IPMA has issued a yellow warning for rain in the Lisboa district, from 2026-11-21 12:00 to 2026-11-21 18:00 local time.
IPMA forecasts a 100% chance of rain in Lisboa tomorrow, 2026-11-21, with a minimum of 14.5 °C and a maximum of 19.2 °C.
Wind is forecast to be moderate from S in Lisboa tomorrow.
Today, 2026-11-20, IPMA forecasts a minimum of 12.9 °C and a maximum of 17.5 °C in Lisboa, with a 33% chance of rain and moderate wind from S.
The IPMA sea forecast for the Lisboa coast on 2026-11-21 gives waves of 1.7 to 2.6 metres from W and a sea temperature of 17.6 to 17.8 °C.
The Lisbon feed links to 'Web Summit opens in Lisbon with humanoid robots as speakers and a focus on physical AI', a story published by portugalglobal.pt, not by PrompTugal.news.
